judge_identity.limitation: requested settings and local lifecycle evidence, not independent provider model or effort attestation

primary_rank_metric.definition: mean of six average-tie item-level Spearman correlations across 48 TRAIN items; undefined if any criterion is constant
primary_rank_metric.interpretation: Thresholds improve this endpoint's primary rank measure, unlike Grok, but the values remain weak and do not establish success.

equal_group_mae.interpretation: Thresholds have lower MAE than direct scores, but both remain worse than fixed three.

human_reference.outbound_target_omission: prevents target leakage; it is not an agreement claim

endpoint_separation: Grok and Sol results remain separate; no pooled metric or cross-endpoint selection is reported.
authority: TRAIN_only_reference_free_HANNA_adaptation; not the original HANNA design of ten systems/stories per prompt with three human raters, and no promotion, runtime, full-CWR-rubric, paper-comparability, or generalization claim
